chat_messages.text:
You're right, I grouped by day. Corrected:

```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS cohort_week FROM users
)
SELECT c.cohort_week, DATE_TRUNC('week', e.occurred_at) AS active_week, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS wau
FROM cohorts c JOIN events e USING (user_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
```

content.text:
You're right, I grouped by day. Corrected:

```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
  SELECT id AS user_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', created_at) AS cohort_week FROM users
)
SELECT c.cohort_week, DATE_TRUNC('week', e.occurred_at) AS active_week, COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS wau
FROM cohorts c JOIN events e USING (user_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2;
```
